notes: MLS Assist v1.36 — Fixed the panel “Pull from chart” button: it now reads the OPEN chart’s patient (name + DOB) and ALL their visits via the frame-aware reader and lands them in MLS, instead of the old top-frame text grab that did nothing on athenaOne. Added READ-ONLY search-and-navigate by name (types “Last, First” into the Athena search bar, opens the matching chart, then pulls visits — never writes/signs). Every Athena action now shares ONE module for live step-by-step status, click-intent labels, exact-destination reporting + save-verify, and self-troubleshooting with adaptive retry. Download and reload at chrome://extensions to update.
